before: Schrijf waar het probleem precies is.
Say exactly where the problem is.

edits.reason: With "Bedenk dit zelf." on c0 and c2 only, the visible criteria imply the location comes from the prompt, whose only location is "in uw straat"; that invites the copy "In mijn straat.", which is neither precise nor the learner's own. The spec says the learner invents the location too; the same pattern is used on the sportclub and nieuwe-patient forms. Quote 1 and starter 1 still fit.
